native_check.scope: Frozen model checked at a larger corpus size; no refit. Same prescribed query distribution and existing query IDs; this checks size transfer, not new-query generalization.

native_models.revision: Median target and small-posting selection term. Prior fits retained; the revised4M check is diagnostic. Freeze this before the8M check.
native_models.scope: Conditional fixed-depth paths, fitted on1M/2M only and checked at4M. All queries remain in measurements. Applicability depends on strong-match counts and native work, not latency. This is not proof of linear transfer to1B or of optimal routing at4M.

warm_leaf_model.scope: Combined leaf cost: preparation, bitmap traversal, scattered scoring and top-K. Repeated timings are not independent queries. This is not a 40GB-buffer validation or a full-search latency model.

fresh_leaf_model.scope: Combined leaf cost: preparation, bitmap traversal, scattered scoring and top-K. Repeated timings are not independent queries. This is not a 40GB-buffer validation or a full-search latency model.
